mapper.select: select rule_id, activity_id, single_invoice_cap, monthly_member_cap, merchant_scope, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from iip_points_rule where activity_id = #{activityId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into iip_points_rule ( activity_id, single_invoice_cap, monthly_member_cap, merchant_scope, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark ) values ( #{activityId}, #{singleInvoiceCap}, #{monthlyMemberCap}, #{merchantScope}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} ) on duplicate key update single_invoice_cap = values(single_invoice_cap), monthly_member_cap = values(monthly_member_cap), merchant_scope = values(merchant_scope), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = sysdate(), remark = values(remark)
